business: Mendez Concrete & Pools (Mendez Concrete Works Solutions)
headline: Google sends people to your new site, but your Nextdoor page still points them to Instagram.
summary: Mendez Concrete & Pools is Fernando Mendez Garcia's concrete and pool contractor in Ramona, licensed C-8 Concrete and C53 Swimming Pool (CSLB #1089745, current and active). Your Google card is up as MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS with your phone, hours, photos, and a link to your Google Site, and you answer neighbors' concrete requests on Nextdoor yourself. The leftover is your Nextdoor page: its website link still goes to an Instagram share link instead of the site your Google card uses.

signals.note: Searching Mendez Concrete Works Solutions, Mendez Concrete Ramona, or (619) 540-1601 on Google Maps opens your card, MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS, listed as a Concrete contractor.
The card, your site, Nextdoor, and your CSLB record all show (619) 540-1601.
When we checked, the card showed 7 AM to 5 PM, matching the 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM hours on Nextdoor.
signals.next: Nothing needed here. Your site does not list hours, if you want to add them.

signals.note: The card has photos, and your Nextdoor page has a photo gallery.
signals.next: Add a recent driveway or pool deck now and then.

signals.note: Your Google Site lists your concrete and pool services, your email, your phone, and your license number. Your Nextdoor page links to instagram.com/mendez_concrete_works instead of this site.
signals.next: Swap the Nextdoor website link to https://sites.google.com/view/mendez-concrete-pools.

signals.note: Your license is under Mendez Concrete Works Solutions, Google and your site say MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS, the Nextdoor page title is CONCRETE & POOLS, and Yelp says Mendez Concrete Works.
signals.next: Pick the name you want neighbors to search for and use it everywhere.
